an4.102:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave cattāro’me valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.102:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā hoti no vassitā?
an4.102:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti:
an4.102:2.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.102:2.4: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.102:2.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā hoti no vassitā.
an4.102:2.6: seyyāthāpi so bhikkhave valāhako gajjitā no vassitā,
an4.102:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo vassitā hoti no gajjitā?
an4.102:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ neva dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti : suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ. so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo vassitā hoti no gajjitā. seyyathāpi so bhikkhave valāhako vassitā no gajjitā, tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi. kathañca bhikkhave puggalo neva gajjitā hoti no vassitā? idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ na pariyāpuṇāti:
an4.102:3.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.102:4.4: nappajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.102:4.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo neva gajjitā hoti no vassitā.
an4.102:4.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave valāhako neva gajjitā no vassitā,
an4.102:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca?
an4.102:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti :
an4.102:5.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.102:5.4: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.102:5.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca.
an4.102:5.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave valāhako gajjitā ca vassitā ca,
an4.102:5.8: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
